reading.label: Checking each quote against its page

facts.label: What you sell
facts.value: Sparkling cold-brewed tea in four flavors: Black Tea and Lemon, Green Tea and Yuzu, Hibiscus and Berry, and Oolong and Peach, all in 12oz cans.
facts.reason: The quote directly lists the four flavors and specifies that they are all in 12oz cans, matching the claim.
facts.quote: Four flavours, all in 12oz cans: Black Tea and Lemon, Green Tea and Yuzu, Hibiscus and Berry, and Oolong and Peach.

facts.label: Where you sell
facts.value: Available in 41 neighborhood shops across Portland and Seattle, including independent grocers, coffee shops, and bottle shops.
facts.reason: The quote confirms the number of shops and locations (Portland and Seattle) but does not specify the types of shops (independent grocers, coffee shops, bottle shops).
facts.quote: You can find Tidewell at 41 neighbourhood shops across Portland and Seattle.

facts.label: Shipping
facts.value: Ships within the US only; no international shipping at this time.
facts.reason: The quote explicitly states that they ship within the US only and do not ship internationally yet, which directly supports the claim.
facts.quote: We ship within the US only. We do not ship internationally yet.

facts.label: Community
facts.value: Sponsors two Portland run clubs: the Alberta Arts Runners and the Sellwood Striders, providing a cooler at their Saturday morning runs finish line.
facts.reason: The quote confirms sponsorship of the two run clubs but does not mention providing a cooler at the finish line of their Saturday morning runs.
facts.quote: This season Tidewell sponsors two Portland run clubs, the Alberta Arts Runners and the Sellwood Striders.

facts.label: Price points
facts.value: A case of 12 cans costs $36; a mixed case of 24 cans costs $68.
facts.reason: The quote exactly matches the pricing information given in the claim for both a case of 12 cans and a mixed case of 24 cans.
facts.quote: A case of 12 cans is $36. A mixed case of 24 cans is $68.

facts.label: Founded
facts.value: Started on a single stall at a neighborhood market in Portland.
facts.reason: The quote directly states that they started on a single stall at a neighborhood market, which supports the claim.
facts.quote: We started on a single stall at a neighbourhood market and now you can find us in shops across Portland and Seattle.
